# Press Releases


Dario Secures Second Women's Health Contract in Just Weeks with The Minnesota Star Tribune


-


-


-


-


*New agreement reflects rapid adoption of recently launched Dario Women™, the Company's women's health solution addressing perimenopause and menopause*


*The Minnesota Star Tribune expands its existing relationship with Dario to amplify cardiometabolic health outcomes with comprehensive women's health support to eligible employees beginning January 2027*


*Nearly 45% of Dario's current book of business is women over age 40, representing a significant opportunity to expand adoption of Dario Women across existing clients already benefitting from its multi-condition platform*


NEW YORK


, Nov. 18, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[DarioHealth Corp.](https://www.dariohealth.com/) (NASDAQ: DRIO) (the "Company", "DarioHealth" or "Dario"), a leading AI-powered healthcare technology company transforming the management of chronic conditions, today announced that[The Minnesota Star Tribune](https://www.startribune.com/) , the Midwest's largest news organization, has expanded its existing contract with Dario to add[Dario Women™](https://dariohealth.investorroom.com/2026-08-04-Dario-Expands-Provider-Backed-Cardiometabolic-Platform-with-New-Womens-Health-and-Sleep-Solutions-Aligning-with-Client-Demand) , the Company's recently launched digital health and clinical care program supporting women navigating perimenopause and menopause. The program is expected to become available to eligible employees in January 2027.


The agreement marks the second employer adoption of Dario Women within just a few weeks, following the recently announced expansion with a leading regional grocery retailer. Launched just a few months ago, Dario Women is already generating commercial traction as employers recognize the need to address the health challenges many women experience during midlife and their potential impact on overall health and healthcare costs, while expanding the value of their existing multi-condition programs.


The Minnesota Star Tribune is the leading Minnesota-based news and media organization with roots dating to 1867. Operating the Midwest's largest newsroom, the company serves audiences through its digital news platforms.


Dario Women builds on Dario's existing cardiometabolic platform by addressing the interconnected health needs of women experiencing perimenopause and menopause. The solution combines DarioIQ's AI-driven engagement and personalization at scale with human-led behavioral coaching and access to licensed healthcare providers, including optional clinical evaluation for hormone replacement therapy when medically appropriate. The program addresses symptoms and health concerns involving weight, sleep, mood, musculoskeletal health and cardiometabolic risk.


"Women's health is an important part of supporting the overall health and well-being of our employees," said Michelle Mueller, Senior Vice President of Human Resources for The Minnesota Star Tribune. "Our experience with Dario's existing programs has demonstrated the value of accessible, personalized health support. Expanding our relationship to include Dario Women allows us to address an important and often underserved area of employee health with a solution that brings together digital engagement, coaching and clinical care."


"Securing two customers for Dario Women within weeks of one another is a strong indication that we identified an important unmet need in the market," said Erez Raphael, Chief Executive Officer of Dario. "Employers are increasingly recognizing that women's health during midlife can be closely connected to cardiometabolic conditions. By adding Dario Women to our existing multi-condition platform, we are able to address more of each member's health needs while creating additional value for our clients. Since close to 45% of our current book of business is comprised of women over age 40, there is an opportunity to extend this solution across our installed base, increasing revenue per customer with minimal incremental customer acquisition investment."


**About DarioHealth Corp.**


DarioHealth (Nasdaq: DRIO) is an AI-powered healthcare technology company helping health plans, health systems and employers improve health outcomes while lowering the cost of care. The Company's integrated platform combines connected devices, personalized member engagement, AI-driven insights and provider-backed clinical care to support people living with conditions including diabetes, hypertension, weight management, musculoskeletal and behavioral health needs.


Powered by more than 13 billion proprietary longitudinal healthcare data points collected over more than a decade, Dario's AI platform personalizes care at the individual member level by analyzing biometric, clinical and behavioral data to deliver more timely and effective interventions. By combining engagement, clinical intelligence and care delivery within a single platform, Dario helps customers address multiple chronic conditions through one solution.


About The Minnesota Star Tribune Media Company


The Minnesota Star Tribune is an innovative modern media organization building on an extraordinary 159-year legacy. With ten Pulitzer Prizes including a 2026 award for breaking news coverage, along with hundreds of other awards, the Minnesota Star Tribune boasts the Midwest's largest newsroom and is an unrivaled force for journalistic excellence in Minnesota and beyond. As the heart and voice of the north, the Minnesota Star Tribune is on a journey to create the leading model for local news in America – driving innovation in media to make every Minnesotan's life better. For more information, visit[www.startribunecompany.com](https://www.startribunecompany.com/) .
